conversations.title: Meeting a New Friend
conversations.description: A casual introduction between two people who just met.

messages.text: Ciao! Io mi chiamo Marco. E tu come ti chiami?
messages.english: Hi! My name is Marco. And what is your name?

choices.text: Ciao Marco, io mi chiamo Luca. Piacere!
choices.english: Hi Marco, my name is Luca. Nice to meet you!

choices.text: Buongiorno, vorrei un caffè per favore.
choices.english: Good morning, I would like a coffee please.
choices.feedback: You are meeting someone, not ordering coffee.

choices.text: Mi scusi, dove sono le chiavi di casa?
choices.english: Excuse me, where are the house keys?
choices.feedback: This is a social introduction, not looking for keys.

messages.text: Piacere mio, Luca! Come va oggi?
messages.english: My pleasure, Luca! How is it going today?

choices.text: Tutto bene, grazie! E tu come stai?
choices.english: Everything is fine, thanks! And how are you?
choices.feedback: Polite and natural way to continue.

choices.text: Sì, la mela è rossa e molto dolce.
choices.english: Yes, the apple is red and very sweet.
choices.feedback: He asked how you are, not about fruit.

choices.text: No, non ho la patente di guida.
choices.english: No, I don't have a driver's license.

messages.text: Bene, grazie. Di dove sei, Luca?
messages.english: Well, thanks. Where are you from, Luca?

choices.text: Sono americano, vengo da New York. E tu?
choices.english: I'm American, I'm from New York. And you?
choices.feedback: Great! You shared your nationality and asked him back.

choices.text: Sono una borsa nera e molto grande.
choices.english: I am a black and very large bag.
choices.feedback: You are a person, not a bag!

choices.text: Ho venti anni e studio medicina a Roma.
choices.english: I'm twenty years old and I study medicine in Rome.
choices.feedback: The question was about where you are from.

messages.text: Io sono italiano, di Roma. Ti piace New York?
messages.english: I am Italian, from Rome. Do you like New York?

choices.text: Sì, è una città molto dinamica.
choices.english: Yes, it's a very dynamic city.

choices.text: No, il gatto dorme sotto il tavolo.
choices.english: No, the cat is sleeping under the table.

choices.text: Sì, mangio sempre la pasta al dente.
choices.english: Yes, I always eat pasta al dente.
choices.feedback: He asked about the city, not food.

messages.text: Immagino! Che lavoro fai?
messages.english: I imagine! What work do you do?

choices.text: Faccio il programmatore. Mi piace molto.
choices.english: I'm a programmer. I like it a lot.
choices.feedback: Correct way to state your profession.

choices.text: Faccio la spesa ogni sabato mattina.
choices.english: I do the shopping every Saturday morning.
choices.feedback: That's a chore, not a profession.

choices.text: Vengo in ufficio con la mia macchina.
choices.english: I come to the office with my car.
choices.feedback: This describes your commute, not your job.

messages.text: Interessante! Lavori in ufficio o a casa?
messages.english: Interesting! Do you work in an office or at home?

choices.text: Lavoro da casa per una grande azienda.
choices.english: I work from home for a big company.
choices.feedback: Clear answer about your work environment.

choices.text: Lavoro con il martello e i chiodi.
choices.english: I work with a hammer and nails.
choices.feedback: You said you were a programmer!

choices.text: No, non ho mai visto quel film.
choices.english: No, I've never seen that movie.

messages.text: Capisco. E vivi qui a Roma adesso?
messages.english: I see. And do you live here in Rome now?

choices.text: Sì, abito qui da due mesi. Mi piace molto.
choices.english: Yes, I've lived here for two months. I like it a lot.

choices.text: No, non mangio mai la carne rossa qui.
choices.english: No, I never eat red meat here.
choices.feedback: The question was about where you live, not your diet.

choices.text: Sì, la stazione è molto vicina a casa.
choices.english: Yes, the station is very close to home.
choices.feedback: This is extra info that doesn't answer the question directly.

messages.text: Bene! Cosa fai nel tempo libero?
messages.english: Good! What do you do in your free time?

choices.text: Mi piace molto viaggiare e leggere libri.
choices.english: I really like traveling and reading books.

choices.text: Mi piace molto dormire sul divano nuovo.
choices.english: I really like sleeping on the new sofa.
choices.feedback: While true, it's not a very engaging hobby for a conversation.

choices.text: Mi piace molto pulire la mia camera.
choices.english: I really like cleaning my room.
choices.feedback: Cleaning is usually a chore, not a hobby.

messages.text: Ottimo. Che tipo di libri leggi di solito?
messages.english: Great. What kind of books do you usually read?

choices.text: Leggo soprattutto romanzi storici.
choices.english: I mostly read historical novels.
choices.feedback: Specifically answers the type of books.

choices.text: Leggo il menu del ristorante ogni giorno.
choices.english: I read the restaurant menu every day.
choices.feedback: That's not exactly reading for a hobby.

choices.text: No, non so scrivere con la penna blu.
choices.english: No, I don't know how to write with a blue pen.
choices.feedback: He asked what you read, not how you write.

messages.text: Anche a me piacciono! Spero di rivederti presto.
messages.english: I like them too! I hope to see you again soon.

choices.text: Certo, a presto Marco! Buona giornata.
choices.english: Sure, see you soon Marco! Have a nice day.
choices.feedback: A polite way to end the conversation.

choices.text: Arrivederci, vorrei il conto per favore.
choices.english: Goodbye, I would like the bill please.

choices.text: Grazie, il treno parte alle tre precise.
choices.english: Thanks, the train leaves at exactly three.
choices.feedback: There is no train in this context.

conversations.title: At a Social Event
conversations.description: Introducing yourself to someone at a party or social gathering.

messages.text: Ciao, sono Giulia. È la tua prima volta qui?
messages.english: Hi, I'm Giulia. Is it your first time here?

choices.text: Sì, è la prima volta. Io sono David.
choices.english: Yes, it's the first time. I am David.

choices.text: No, non ho mai mangiato questa pizza.
choices.english: No, I've never eaten this pizza.
choices.feedback: She asked if it's your first time here, not about the food.

choices.text: Sì, il bagno è in fondo al corridoio.
choices.english: Yes, the bathroom is at the end of the hallway.
choices.feedback: You are giving directions instead of introducing yourself.

messages.text: Piacere David! Ti piace questa festa?
messages.english: Nice to meet you David! Do you like this party?

choices.text: Sì, c'è molta gente simpatica.
choices.english: Yes, there are many nice people.

choices.text: No, le mie scarpe sono troppo strette.
choices.english: No, my shoes are too tight.

choices.text: Sì, il cielo è pieno di nuvole grigie.
choices.english: Yes, the sky is full of gray clouds.
choices.feedback: You are likely indoors at a party.

messages.text: Vero! Piacere di conoscerti. Lavori qui in città?
messages.english: True! Nice to meet you. Do you work here in the city?

choices.text: Sì, faccio l'architetto in uno studio.
choices.english: Yes, I work as an architect in a studio.
choices.feedback: Perfect way to state your job and location.

choices.text: No, preferisco andare al cinema da solo.
choices.english: No, I prefer going to the cinema alone.

choices.text: Sì, la città è molto grande e rumorosa.
choices.english: Yes, the city is very big and noisy.
choices.feedback: You're describing the city instead of answering about your work.

messages.text: Bello! Ti piace il tuo lavoro?
messages.english: Nice! Do you like your job?

choices.text: Sì, molto. È un lavoro creativo.
choices.english: Yes, a lot. It's a creative job.

choices.text: No, non bevo mai latte la mattina.
choices.english: No, I never drink milk in the morning.

choices.text: Sì, la sedia è molto comoda oggi.
choices.english: Yes, the chair is very comfortable today.

messages.text: Capisco. E quali sono i tuoi hobby preferiti?
messages.english: I see. And what are your favorite hobbies?

choices.text: Mi piace suonare la chitarra e nuotare.
choices.english: I like playing the guitar and swimming.

choices.text: Mi piace bere l'acqua quando ho sete.
choices.english: I like drinking water when I'm thirsty.
choices.feedback: Drinking water is a basic need, not a hobby.

choices.text: Mi piace chiudere la porta a chiave.
choices.english: I like locking the door.
choices.feedback: That is an action, not a hobby.

messages.text: Suoni la chitarra? Fantastico! Da quanto tempo?
messages.english: You play the guitar? Fantastic! For how long?

choices.text: Suono da circa cinque anni.
choices.english: I've been playing for about five years.

choices.text: Suono il clacson della mia macchina.
choices.english: I honk the horn of my car.

choices.text: Cinque euro per un kg di mele.
choices.english: Five euros for one kg of apples.

messages.text: Complimenti! Ti piace la musica rock?
messages.english: Well done! Do you like rock music?

choices.text: Sì, molto! Ascolto molta musica rock.
choices.english: Yes, a lot! I listen to a lot of rock music.
choices.feedback: Good follow-up on the music topic.

choices.text: No, non ho mai comprato una chitarra.
choices.english: No, I've never bought a guitar.
choices.feedback: But you just said you play it!

choices.text: Sì, il rock è un tipo di sasso duro.
choices.english: Yes, rock is a type of hard stone.
choices.feedback: In this context, rock refers to the music genre.

messages.text: Bello! Anch'io ascolto molta musica. Hai una band?
messages.english: Nice! I listen to a lot of music too. Do you have a band?

choices.text: No, suono solo per divertimento.
choices.english: No, I only play for fun.

choices.text: Sì, ho una benda sull'occhio destro.
choices.english: Yes, I have a bandage on my right eye.

choices.text: Sì, la banda è molto larga qui.
choices.english: Yes, the band is very wide here.

messages.text: Capito. È stato un piacere parlare con te.
messages.english: Understood. It was a pleasure talking to you.

choices.text: Anche per me, Giulia! A più tardi.
choices.english: Me too, Giulia! See you later.

choices.text: Anche io ho fame, dove sono i panini?
choices.english: I'm hungry too, where are the sandwiches?
choices.feedback: A bit rude when someone is being polite.

choices.text: Anche la mia macchina è blu metallizzata.
choices.english: My car is also metallic blue.

messages.text: A più tardi David, divertiti!
messages.english: See you later David, have fun!

choices.text: Grazie, anche a te! Ciao.
choices.english: Thanks, you too! Bye.

choices.text: Prego, quanto costa il biglietto?
choices.english: You're welcome, how much is the ticket?

choices.text: No, non mi piace ballare.
choices.english: No, I don't like dancing.

conversations.title: Talking about Nationalities
conversations.description: Discussing where you and others are from in a social setting.

messages.text: Ciao, io sono Sofia. Sei straniero, vero?
messages.english: Hi, I'm Sofia. You're a foreigner, right?

choices.text: Sì, sono francese. Vengo da Parigi.
choices.english: Yes, I'm French. I'm from Paris.

choices.text: No, il passaporto è nella mia borsa.
choices.english: No, the passport is in my bag.
choices.feedback: She didn't ask for your passport.

choices.text: Sì, la Francia è una nazione europea.
choices.english: Yes, France is a European nation.
choices.feedback: A bit too formal and doesn't introduce yourself.

messages.text: Ah, Parigi è bellissima! Ti manca la tua città?
messages.english: Ah, Paris is beautiful! Do you miss your city?

choices.text: Sì, un po', ma mi piace molto l'Italia.
choices.english: Yes, a little, but I really like Italy.

choices.text: No, ho perso le chiavi della città.
choices.english: No, I lost the keys to the city.

choices.text: Sì, la città è fatta di case e strade.
choices.english: Yes, the city is made of houses and streets.

messages.text: Che bello! E cosa fai di bello qui in Italia?
messages.english: How nice! And what are you doing here in Italy?

choices.text: Studio l'italiano in una scuola di lingue.
choices.english: I study Italian in a language school.
choices.feedback: Explains your purpose in Italy clearly.

choices.text: Compro solo vestiti di marca e costosi.
choices.english: I only buy expensive designer clothes.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant and sounds a bit boastful.

choices.text: Guardo la televisione ogni sera a casa.
choices.english: I watch television every evening at home.
choices.feedback: Doesn't explain why you are in Italy.

messages.text: Capito. Studi l'italiano da molto tempo?
messages.english: I see. Have you been studying Italian for a long time?

choices.text: Studio da circa tre mesi.
choices.english: I've been studying for about three months.

choices.text: Sì, lo studio del dottore è chiuso.
choices.english: Yes, the doctor's office is closed.

choices.text: No, non ho mai mangiato lo studio.
choices.english: No, I've never eaten the study.

messages.text: Ottimo! Ti piace vivere qui in Italia?
messages.english: Great! Do you like living here in Italy?

choices.text: Sì, mi piace molto il cibo e la gente.
choices.english: Yes, I really like the food and the people.

choices.text: No, il treno per Parigi è molto veloce.
choices.english: No, the train to Paris is very fast.

choices.text: Sì, l'Italia ha una forma di stivale.
choices.english: Yes, Italy is shaped like a boot.
choices.feedback: A geographical fact, not your opinion on living there.

messages.text: È vero, la gente è molto calorosa. Hai amici qui?
messages.english: It's true, the people are very warm. Do you have friends here?

choices.text: Sì, ho alcuni amici a scuola.
choices.english: Yes, I have some friends at school.

choices.text: No, non ho mai comprato un amico.
choices.english: No, I've never bought a friend.

choices.text: Sì, il mio amico è un ombrello rosso.
choices.english: Yes, my friend is a red umbrella.

messages.text: Sono felice di sentirlo! Qual è la tua città preferita?
messages.english: I'm happy to hear that! What is your favorite city?

choices.text: Mi piace molto Firenze per l'arte.
choices.english: I like Florence very much for its art.

choices.text: La mia città ha molti semafori rossi.
choices.english: My city has many red traffic lights.

choices.text: Preferisco mangiare la pasta al forno.
choices.english: I prefer eating baked pasta.
choices.feedback: The question was about a city, not food.

messages.text: Firenze è stupenda! Sei già stato agli Uffizi?
messages.english: Florence is wonderful! Have you already been to the Uffizi?

choices.text: Sì, è un museo incredibile.
choices.english: Yes, it's an incredible museum.

choices.text: No, non ho mai mangiato gli uffici.
choices.english: No, I've never eaten the offices.

choices.text: Sì, il mio ufficio è molto piccolo.
choices.english: Yes, my office is very small.

messages.text: Concordo. Buona permanenza, allora!
messages.english: I agree. Have a good stay, then!

choices.text: Grazie mille Sofia, a presto!
choices.english: Thanks a lot Sofia, see you soon!

choices.text: Prego, vorrei un altro bicchiere d'acqua.
choices.english: You're welcome, I would like another glass of water.

choices.text: Sì, il museo apre alle nove domani.
choices.english: Yes, the museum opens at nine tomorrow.

messages.text: Arrivederci Sofia, è stato un piacere!
messages.english: Goodbye Sofia, it was a pleasure!

choices.text: Piacere mio, a presto! Ciao.
choices.english: My pleasure, see you soon! Bye.

choices.text: No, non mi piace il piacere.
choices.english: No, I don't like pleasure.

choices.text: Sì, la sedia è di legno scuro.
choices.english: Yes, the chair is made of dark wood.

conversations.title: Sharing Hobbies
conversations.description: A conversation about what you like to do in your free time.

messages.text: Ciao! Ti piace questo evento? Io sono Paolo.
messages.english: Hi! Do you like this event? I'm Paolo.

choices.text: Ciao Paolo! Sì, è molto divertente.
choices.english: Hi Paolo! Yes, it's very fun.

choices.text: Buongiorno, ho bisogno di un dottore.
choices.english: Good morning, I need a doctor.

choices.text: No, non mi piacciono le scarpe strette.
choices.english: No, I don't like tight shoes.
choices.feedback: He asked about the event, not your shoes.

messages.text: Bene! E tu cosa fai di solito per divertirti?
messages.english: Good! And what do you usually do for fun?

choices.text: Mi piace molto fare sport e viaggiare.
choices.english: I really like doing sports and traveling.

choices.text: Di solito dormo dodici ore ogni notte.
choices.english: I usually sleep twelve hours every night.
choices.feedback: Sleeping isn't usually considered a hobby for fun.

choices.text: Vado in bagno due volte al giorno.
choices.english: I go to the bathroom twice a day.

messages.text: Viaggiare è stupendo! Dove sei stato di recente?
messages.english: Traveling is wonderful! Where have you been recently?

choices.text: Sono stato a Venezia il mese scorso.
choices.english: I was in Venice last month.
choices.feedback: Specific answer to a travel question.

choices.text: Sono stato un po' male ieri sera.
choices.english: I was a bit sick last night.

choices.text: No, non ho mai mangiato una città.
choices.english: No, I've never eaten a city.

messages.text: Venezia è magica! E che sport pratichi di solito?
messages.english: Venice is magical! And what sport do you usually practice?

choices.text: Io gioco a tennis e vado a nuotare.
choices.english: I play tennis and I go swimming.

choices.text: Io mangio una mela ogni pomeriggio.
choices.english: I eat an apple every afternoon.
choices.feedback: Eating an apple is not a sport.

choices.text: Il calcio è uno sport molto popolare.
choices.english: Soccer is a very popular sport.
choices.feedback: You're making a general statement instead of sharing your sport.

messages.text: Il nuoto è ottimo! Ti piace anche la musica?
messages.english: Swimming is great! Do you also like music?

choices.text: Sì, adoro ascoltare musica classica.
choices.english: Yes, I love listening to classical music.

choices.text: No, non so dove sia la radio adesso.
choices.english: No, I don't know where the radio is now.
choices.feedback: The question is about your taste, not the location of a radio.

choices.text: Sì, la musica è fatta di note e suoni.
choices.english: Yes, music is made of notes and sounds.

messages.text: Interessante. Qual è il tuo compositore preferito?
messages.english: Interesting. Who is your favorite composer?

choices.text: Mi piace molto Vivaldi.
choices.english: I like Vivaldi very much.

choices.text: Mi piace molto il formaggio fresco.
choices.english: I like fresh cheese very much.
choices.feedback: He asked about a composer, not food.

choices.text: Vivaldi è una marca di scarpe?
choices.english: Is Vivaldi a shoe brand?

messages.text: Ottima scelta! Suoni anche qualche strumento?
messages.english: Excellent choice! Do you also play any instrument?

choices.text: No, purtroppo non so suonare.
choices.english: No, unfortunately I don't know how to play.

choices.text: Sì, suono il campanello di casa.
choices.english: Yes, I ring the doorbell.

choices.text: Sì, il pianoforte è molto pesante.
choices.english: Yes, the piano is very heavy.

messages.text: Non è mai troppo tardi per imparare! Ti piace il cinema?
messages.english: It's never too late to learn! Do you like cinema?

choices.text: Sì, vado al cinema ogni weekend.
choices.english: Yes, I go to the cinema every weekend.

choices.text: No, preferisco guardare il muro.
choices.english: No, I prefer looking at the wall.

choices.text: Sì, lo schermo è molto grande.
choices.english: Yes, the screen is very big.

messages.text: Anch'io! Allora ci vediamo in giro. Ciao!
messages.english: Me too! See you around, then. Bye!

choices.text: Certamente, a presto Paolo! Ciao.
choices.english: Certainly, see you soon Paolo! Bye.

choices.text: Prego, il conto è di venti euro.
choices.english: You're welcome, the bill is twenty euros.

choices.text: No, preferisco restare qui a guardare.
choices.english: No, I prefer staying here to watch.
choices.feedback: He was saying goodbye, not asking you to leave.

messages.text: Ciao Paolo, a presto!
messages.english: Bye Paolo, see you soon!

choices.text: Arrivederci e buona serata!
choices.english: Goodbye and have a good evening!

choices.text: Sì, il sole tramonta a ovest.
choices.english: Yes, the sun sets in the west.

choices.text: Grazie, vorrei comprare un giornale.
choices.english: Thanks, I would like to buy a newspaper.
